discrimination_wording: Threshold-independent discrimination is reported using ROC-AUC. Threshold-dependent operating performance is reported separately using held-out balanced accuracy, sensitivity and specificity.

rows.interpretation_flags: useful discrimination; threshold-sensitive (held-out balanced accuracy shifts vs 0.50); high validation-selected threshold (>0.90); see high-threshold note
rows.score_semantics: Raw model fake_score from saved inference outputs. Not a calibrated probability or confidence. Higher values indicate the model assigned relatively more mass to the fake token versus real at the scored step.
